layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Dromaeosaurid pennaceous feather morphology
features: A close-up view of a dinosaur's wing-like forearm showcasing advanced pennaceous feathers
The feathers have a clear central clay rachis (quill) with flat, interlocking barbs creating a smooth blade-like surface
The clay feathers are arranged in neat, overlapping layers, colored in deep navy blue with black and white striped patterns
The dinosaur's body underneath shows dark, pebbled clay skin
The feathers have a slight sheen, as if sculpted from polished, high-quality clay
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic profile shot of the fanned-out feathers on the arm. The lighting is crisp, highlighting the edges and the structured, symmetrical look of the 'true' feathers. This serves as a 'Pennaceous Feather' morphology icon. No text.
